expectations: Standalone direct-file initial bundled preview identifies actual bundled title/attribution/license; session starts only through Start this course.
First bundled item is p1, then p2 after explicit self-judgment, preserving source order.
Before Reveal, rendered active card contains prompt and optional own-answer input but none of its options, correct-answer text, explanation or transfer.
Reveal and compare exposes exact correct option, explanation and transfer as text, and the learner's retained own answer; Ready for now and Revisit are explicit self-judgments.
Keyboard Enter/Space and focus navigation activate Start, Reveal and judgment. No app/model state injection.
Validated real local three-item fixture preview does not change existing session; only explicit Start does.
Source order z-first,a-second,m-third despite lexical/concept prerequisite order; answer indices 2,1,0 distinguish using the actual correct option.
Own answers first-one, empty optional response, first-three; initial judgments Revisit, Ready for now, Revisit.
Exactly one additional pass contains z-first,m-third in source order; own answers second-one and second-three; judgments Ready for now, Revisit.
Five chronological attempts remain visible, preserving both answers and judgments for revisited items; second-pass Revisit does not enqueue a third pass.
No scoring/mastery is asserted or generated; readiness is self-reported.
Actual text input admits 4000 UTF-16 code units, including 2000 astral symbols; native attempted insertion beyond the bound cannot produce a stored answer longer than4000.
Reveal preserves exact allowed own answer as text.
Start over requests explicit confirmation. Keep my work preserves active item, own answer, reveal phase and prior attempts.
Start over and clear attempts resets to source-first prompt with hidden answer, empty own answer and cleared attempts; no old response retained in displayed history.
Real File inputs use unchanged validator and262144-byte UTF8JSON limit; exactly262144 accepted,262145 rejected although decoded UTF16 length is below bytecap.
MalformedUTF8 bytes and UTF16-encoded JSON are refused; strict malformedJSON/schema/cycle/duplicateID controls are refused.
Each invalid read preserves prior session prompt, own response, phase and attempts while showing an actionable error.
Valid replacement preview and Cancel preview preserve current work; canceled/empty file selection does not clear it.
Literal harmless markup, quotes and ampersands remain text; no active resource/event payload is used.
Delay only selected synthetic fixture File read completion at browser File/Blob/FileReader boundary; still use real input File objects, bytes, decoder, parser and validator.
SlowvalidA followed by fastvalidB leaves B as preview after A resolves; established session unchanged until explicit Start.
SlowinvalidA completed after fastvalidB cannot erase B or replace its successful preview with an obsolete error.
Cancel preview after an admitted replacement preserves the prior session; driver records exactly which delayed-reader/cancel branch actually executed.
This qualifies controlled asynchronous browser reads, not a human OS picker or disk-performance test.
Fresh390px viewport displays bounded long unbroken title, prompt, correct option, explanation, transfer, attribution and license without horizontal document overflow.
Pre-Reveal rendered card still omits all answer material. After explicit Reveal exact long text is reachable and visible by scrolling.
Primary controls remain keyboard reachable and usable; attribution and license remain available.
Inspect actual before/after screenshots. No screen-reader or whole-app accessibility claim.

invariant.network: Block and record all HTTP(S); direct-file isolated contexts only, no provider/service/user profile.
invariant.source: Pin full candidate execution closure before running and verify bytes unchanged afterward.
invariant.run_count: Only these needed groups, retain every failed attempt, no full suite or Actions.
invariant.oracle_binding: Candidate implementation not read before freeze; later adapters may bind accessible controls to this oracle but may not silently change expected behavior.
invariant.artifacts: Actual chosen fixture files, browser event/download data if any, screenshots, stdout/stderr and exact source hashes retained.
